medium: royal-blue ground with rounded dark-navy map cards, red-orange trading-card insets and dashed routes; dark-green infographics with arc diagrams and bar charts; headline cards on blue; broadcast sports footage and archival photos; white monospace captions in a navy box
avoid: cartoon, hand-drawn sketch, white backgrounds, 3D render, text baked into the image
note: Typed by hand 2026-09-14 (replaces the automatic looks, which had four stills and generic rules). Captions sit at 0.72-0.78 so stills are cropped to the top 69%. Real players, officials and suspects are never generated. Caption: white monospace in a dark-navy box, centred low.

looks.label: Map card with trading-card insets
looks.when: the default - a player, a team, a move between places, who went where: a map card with small card insets and a route.
looks.prompt: A rounded dark-navy card on a flat royal-blue ground: a simplified map with land in off-white and grey, one or two small red-orange trading-card frames pinned onto it, tiny team badges, a dashed route line across the water; clean flat vector, small drop shadow, any lettering as illegible marks.

looks.label: Dark-green infographic
looks.when: numbers, shares, structures - who owns what, how many, revenue over time - as a diagram on dark green.
looks.prompt: A flat infographic on a dark forest-green ground: a semicircle divided into wedges with clusters of small white dots, or a simple bar chart in cyan and red on a darker green panel, thin white lines, a small round photo slot at the centre left blank; labels as illegible marks.

looks.label: Headline card on blue
looks.when: a source is cited - a newspaper headline, a report - as a typographic card.
looks.prompt: A flat royal-blue card: a small grey source line at the top left, three lines of bold headline text in lime green and white rendered as illegible strokes, a short paragraph of tiny grey marks beneath, and one small square photo lower right. Nothing else.

looks.label: Investigation board on dark
looks.when: an investigation - documents, a world map with routes, screenshots, wanted posters - pinned on a dark ground.
looks.prompt: A dark charcoal ground with evidence laid out flat: a dark-green world map with thin red route lines and small pins, a printed document or phone screenshot, a wanted poster with a red header, connected by thin lines; documentary, slightly desaturated, any lettering as illegible marks.

looks.label: Broadcast sports footage
looks.when: a game, a pitch, a swing, a match - shown as broadcast footage.
looks.prompt: A frame of broadcast sports footage: a player mid-action seen from a distance or from behind on a green field or in a batting cage, soft video quality, natural stadium light, crowd blurred, no faces readable, no text.

looks.label: Black-and-white archival photo
looks.when: the past - early days of a sport, an old team, a historic moment - as an old photograph.
looks.prompt: A black-and-white archival photograph: players on a dusty field decades ago, soft grain, slight fading, mid-distance, filling the frame; no text.

looks.label: News image of a real person
looks.when: a named official, player or suspect - real footage only, never generated.

looks.label: Creator on camera
looks.when: the creator on camera - never generated.
